item.title: C/C++ Rendering Engines Collection
item.description:
Overview

A polished and optimized collection of rendering engines implementing various graphics techniques from first principles.

Engines Included

  • Raycasting Engine: Classic raycasting implementation for pseudo-3D rendering

  • Raytracing Engine: Physically-based ray tracing with reflection, refraction, and global illumination

  • Voxel Engine: Volumetric rendering for voxel-based worlds with efficient spatial data structures

  • Rasterizer: Software rasterization pipeline implementing the full graphics pipeline

Technical Highlights

Each engine is implemented in pure C/C++ with a focus on performance optimization and clean, educational code structure.
